test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

g _ o _ d k _ m _ f _ o _ k k _ g f o _ d _ k m

options.text: f o k g o d m o k
f o k g o d f o k
f o k d o d m o k
f o k g o d m o m

solution:
Given :- g _ o _ d k _ m _ f _ o _ k k _ g f o _ d _ k m

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) f o k g o d m o k → g **f** o **o** d k **k** m - **g** f **o** o **d** k k **m** - g f o **o** d **k** k m

 
• Here **"gfoodkkm"** is repeated

2) f o k g o d f o k
